summary: Decent Holding Inc. (NASDAQ: DXST), a PRC-based environmental services company, furnished a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing an updated company PowerPoint presentation attached as Exhibit 99.1. The presentation highlights wastewater treatment, river water quality management and microbial products as the core business, with a focused AI extension in senior health and wellness. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure of investor materials, not a special situation; watch only for any follow-on capital or strategic action referenced in the deck.
